name: code-project-guidance-map
description: Create self-hashed AGENTS.md project indexes and manifest-backed guide trees for Codex project editing.

interface.shortDescription: Create self-hashed AGENTS.md indexes and guide trees.
interface.longDescription: Builds and refreshes a marker-delimited AGENTS.md project index plus a self-hashed manifest-backed Markdown guide tree under .agents/guidance-map/guides. AGENTS.md stays compact with editing rules, task routing, dependency rules, a manifest pointer, and only its own short content hash; freshness cursors live in .agents/guidance-map/manifest.json, and each guide carries its own content hash. Non-structural refreshes preserve AGENTS.md byte-for-byte. Query validates selected guide identities and self-hashes before recommending them, and full verification can scan every guide. A modification-only Stop hook checks Git-visible changes without injecting startup or prompt context; it stays silent while a builder is active so the caller task never waits for builder completion. Ordinary tasks request refreshes through the helper build command; the helper enforces one active script-coordinated Codex builder task per repository and synchronizes later request context into it. Auto launcher selection follows the request origin: Desktop requests prefer a newly created Desktop task, while CLI requests prefer `codex exec`. The caller finalizes immediately after start, queue, or Desktop attach.
defaultPrompt: Use $code-project-guidance-map to refresh the self-hashed AGENTS.md guidance map via its single builder.
